title: Escondite Cubo
game_overview: An engaging children's hide-and-seek game where adorable blocky characters hide behind large objects, featuring peek animations and color-based hints.
winning_condition: Tap the correct hiding object to reveal and celebrate the hidden blocky character.
losing_condition: None (stress-free exploration with gentle visual feedback on incorrect guesses).

controls.action: Inspect the object to find the hidden blocky character.
Open configuration drawer to toggle objects, characters, and count per round (1-8).
Start a new round with the configured settings.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Intuitive Delight: Large, vibrant tactile objects with gentle floating micro-animations. 2. Progressive Peeking: The hidden character stays concealed for 3 seconds, then playfully peeks with subtle transparency and gradual reveal tiers. 3. Friendly Guidance: After 10 seconds without a correct guess, clear bilingual color badges (e.g., 'Naranja Ladrillo' & 'Gris Cemento') guide the young player without pressure.
sections.summary: Core pillars: Intuitive Delight, Child-Centric Accessibility, and Playful Discovery.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: At the start of each round, a selected blocky buddy swiftly runs behind one of the active hiding objects. For the first 3 seconds, the character remains fully hidden while the objects gently sway. At 3.0s, peeking animations begin periodically revealing subtle angles. At 10.0s, a distinct color clue ribbon highlights 1 or 2 specific prominent hues of the hiding spot. Tapping the correct object triggers a joyful victory dance and bursting confetti, while wrong guesses produce gentle pastel puffs.
sections.summary: Round starts -> Character hides -> Subtle peeks begin after 3s -> Clue at 10s -> Correct tap triggers dance & grand confetti -> Next round.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Non-Overlapping Procedural Placement: Automatically distributes 1 to 8 large objects across the screen adapted for both portrait and landscape viewports. 2. Staged Reveal System: Initial 3s total stealth, followed by incremental peeks (ears/hat peak, side peek, half face peek with fade-in/out). 3. Precise Color Clue: Two-color curated swatch pills with clear friendly names matching the target object. 4. Admin Management: In-game modal allowing real-time selection of active objects, enabled voxel characters, and round object counts.
sections.summary: Dynamic object placement, progressive peeking system, targeted color hints, and full Admin panel customization.

sections.title: Movement & Scrolling Alignment
sections.content: Scrolling Axis: Static single-screen viewport with automatic responsive resizing. Asset Orientation: All objects and characters face forward/slightly isometric. Movement Physics: Smooth sine-wave idle swaying for objects and spring-damped bouncing for character reveals. Camera Behavior: Locked widescreen/portrait responsive camera.
sections.summary: Fixed single-screen playfield with responsive CSS/Canvas coordinates and micro-floating dynamics.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Layer Separation: Soft sky and meadow gradient backdrop in the background layer (zero interaction). Midground holds the large stylized hiding objects and character peeking z-indices. Foreground hosts interactive particles, celebratory confetti, and the clean top HUD ribbon with Admin toggle.
sections.summary: High contrast playfield with crisp foreground layers and clean pastel backdrop.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content: 1. Cubito el Explorador: Blue cap, beige jacket, cute pixel eyes. 2. Robo-Bloque: Metallic teal cube with glowing cyan visor and antenna. 3. Dino-Cubo: Lime green blocky dinosaur with yellow dorsal spikes. 4. Gatito Pixel: Orange tabby voxel kitten with cute whiskers and pointy ears. No enemies; pure discovery and celebration.
sections.summary: Four original friendly voxel avatars: Cubito el Explorador, Robo-Bloque, Dino-Cubo, and Gatito Pixel.

sections.title: Fairness Tools
sections.content: After 10 seconds of searching, an animated clue banner pops up showing exact color swatches with descriptive labels (e.g., 'Verde Pino' & 'Café Roble'). Missing an object gives soft, encouraging feedback without penalty.
sections.summary: Timed multi-color hint system and gentle feedback on miss.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Floating object idle sway and cursor hover squash. State Change Juice: Color hint badge pop with glowing pulse. Impact/Resolution Juice: Massive multi-colored confetti fountain, golden star particles, and celebratory character dance accompanied by playful procedural audio synthesis.
sections.summary: Bouncy squash-and-stretch taps, multi-colored particle confetti bursts, and celebratory victory dance.

sections.title: Social Mechanics & Audience
sections.content: Designed for toddlers, preschoolers, and early learners with big tap targets, clear visual language, and no reading barrier required to play.
sections.summary: Child-friendly singleplayer game suitable for early childhood, families, and classrooms.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: Generous touch targets (>80px), distinct object silhouettes, labeled color hints with high-contrast text badges, and full keyboard/touch/mouse compatibility.
sections.summary: High-contrast visual cues, large interactive hitboxes, responsive touch support, and colorblind-safe labeled hints.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Instant play on load -> Smooth round transitions -> Overlay Admin Drawer with persistent settings saved in localStorage -> No loading screens or disruptive popups.
sections.summary: Clean single-screen flow with seamless Admin Drawer and instant round resets.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: All gameplay elements use pointerdown/touchstart listeners with touch-action: manipulation to eliminate mobile tap latency, prevent accidental scrolling, and support rapid fluid tapping.
sections.summary: Native responsive touch interaction across all screen sizes and orientations.
